simple.meaning: שָׁוָה (shâvâh) appears 21 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Samuel, Esther, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, and 3 more, beginning at 2 Samuel 22:34. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as Torah, kingship.

definitions.short: properly, to level , i.e. equalize ; figuratively, to resemble ; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.)
definitions.usage: avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-) like, make plain, profit, reckon.
definitions.full: H7737. shavah I. שָׁוָה verb ( be even, smooth , see Pi`el , hence) agree with, be like, resemble (Arabic II. make even, flat, uniform (with something else); Aramaic שְׁוָא (derived species) be like , be equal, fit, like , Pa`el lay out smoothly , Aph`el make plain, fit, worthy ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular שׁ ׳לֹא לִי Job 33:27 (si vera lectio) it was not equalled to me , i.e. (see infra; according to most) not requited (so De Di Da, and Isa 16:6 ᵑ7 ); Bu שִׁוָּה לֹא אֵל God did not requite (or שִׁלֵּם for שׁוה ); Du כַעֲוֺנִי שִׁוָּה לֹא (compare ᵐ5 ); Imperfect 1singular of אֶשְׁוֶה ֗֗֗ אֶלמִֿי ׳י, 40:25 to whom shall I be like ? (|| תְּדַמְּיוּנִי ), implying that he is incompare; 3 masculine plural יִשְׁווּבָֿהּ לֹא Prov 3:15 are not comparable with her (wisdom), so 8:11 ; 2 masculine singular מֶּןתִּֿשְׁוֶהלֿוֺ 26:4 lest thou be like him (a fool); Participle בְּ שֹׁוֶה Est 7:4 is not an equivalent for ; with לִ , suitable for 3:8 , so 1:22 Hi Or Ry Kau (reading עִמּוֺ שֹׁוֶה כֹּל for עַמּוֺ כִּלְשׁוֺן , but see Siegf.); adequate for 5:13 . Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular שִׁוָּה Isa 28:25 he hath levelled its (the ground's) surface; 1 singular נַפְשִׁי וְדוֺמַמְתִּי שִׁוִּיתִי Psa 131:2 I have smoothed (composed) and stilled my soul ; so, that is נַפְשִׁי Isa 38:13 ᵑ9 Ges De and others; Houb Lo Che Du and others read שִׁוַּעְתִּי I cried ; accusative מִשְׁמָּטִים Psa 119:30 accounted suitable , meet (|| בָּחָ֑רְתִּי אֱמוּנָח דֶּרֶךְ ), Hi, compare Gr 119:128 (see Qal Est 3:8 ); We inserts לְנֶגְדִּי (II. ׳שׁ , compare Psa 16:8 ); Zenner Du אִזִּיתִי . occurrences.englishText: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet,

Haman said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom, and their laws are different from other people’s. They don’t keep the king’s laws. Therefore it is not for the king’s profit to allow them to remain.
Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”

For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”
He sings before men, and says,
I have set Yahweh always before me.
He teaches my hands to war,
For you make him most blessed forever.
I have found David, my servant.
I have chosen the way of truth.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul,
She is more precious than rubies.
For wisdom is better than rubies.
Don’t answer a fool according to his folly,
A continual dropping on a rainy day
When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?
I waited patiently until morning.
“To whom then will you liken me?
“To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal,
What shall I testify to you?
Israel is a luxuriant vine that produces his fruit.
